description: List facilities whose current EPA compliance status is a violation (Violation Identified, Significant Violation, or Violation), worst first: significant violations first, then most quarters in noncompliance, then largest penalties. Filter by state, by county (requires state), or by program (CAA, CWA, SDWA, RCRA, TRI, GHG). Useful for screening an area or a program for current environmental compliance problems. Each result shows the facility's name, city, state, ZIP and county, its EPA programs, compliance status, quarters in noncompliance, inspection and formal-action counts, and total penalties. Returns at most `limit` results (default 50, max 500) with no offset paging.

program.description: Program code: CAA, CWA, SDWA, RCRA, TRI, or GHG

name: list_facilities_with_violations
